West Palm Beach Real Estate

Welcome to West Palm Beach, Florida – a vibrant coastal city that embodies the perfect blend of sun-soaked beaches, lush landscapes, and a dynamic cultural scene. Nestled in Palm Beach County, this charming city is renowned for its year-round warm climate and stunning waterfront views, making it an ideal destination for both residents and visitors alike.

West Palm Beach is a city that thrives on its rich history and diverse community. The downtown area is bustling with life, featuring an array of trendy shops, gourmet restaurants, and lively entertainment options. The iconic Clematis Street is a must-visit, where you can soak in the local atmosphere, enjoy live music, and explore art galleries that showcase the talents of regional artists.

For nature enthusiasts, West Palm Beach boasts beautiful parks and pristine beaches. The picturesque waterfront along the Intracoastal Waterway offers the perfect backdrop for leisurely strolls, picnics, or simply relaxing in the sun. The nearby Okeeheelee Park and Grassy Waters Preserve provide ample opportunities for hiking, birdwatching, and embracing the natural beauty of Florida’s unique ecosystems.

Culturally rich, West Palm Beach is home to the renowned Kravis Center for the Performing Arts, where you can catch Broadway shows, concerts, and dance performances. The Norton Museum of Art showcases an impressive collection of American, European, and Chinese art, making it a cultural hub for art lovers.

Whether you’re looking to enjoy a vibrant nightlife, indulge in outdoor adventures, or immerse yourself in the arts, West Palm Beach has something for everyone. Come discover the charm of this coastal gem and make it your home in paradise!

Located in the highly desirable SoSo (South of Southern) neighborhood, one of the most sought-after communities in West Palm Beach, this stunning new construction residence, completed in 2024, offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and modern design. Featuring 4 bedrooms plus a den, 3 full bathrooms, and 1 half bath, this thoughtfully designed two-story home is just steps from the Intracoastal Waterway. The expansive open-concept floor plan showcases a grand living area that seamlessly connects the family room, dining area, and gourmet kitchen, creating an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. The sleek chef's kitchen features a walk-in pantry, modern finishes, and abundant storage. Large impact-resistant windows and doors flood the home with natural light while providing a seamless connection to the outdoor living spaces. The first-floor primary suite offers a private retreat with convenient access to the home's main living areas, while additional bedrooms and flexible living space provide ample room for family, guests, or a home office. Enjoy Florida living at its finest with a welcoming front porch and a private interior courtyard designed for relaxation and entertaining. Ideally situated near top-rated schools, shopping, dining, and recreational amenities, this exceptional home is only 10 minutes from Downtown West Palm Beach, 7 minutes from Palm Beach International Airport, and just one block from the renowned Park Golf Course. Experience the best of South Florida living in one of West Palm Beach's most coveted waterfront-adjacent neighborhoods.

Step into SoSo's most captivating reimagined jewel. This 1926 Spanish-Mediterranean masterpiece was masterfully reborn in 2026, offering timeless romance with uncompromising modern sophistication. Enter through lush landscaping to a private Chicago-brick courtyard anchored by a shimmering saltwater plunge pool and tranquil water feature — your personal Mediterranean oasis. Inside, an original wood-burning fireplace and signature spiral staircase greet you, while expansive sliders flood the formal living areas with light. The chef's kitchen features marble slab counters, a full backsplash, and Thermador appliances including a 6-burner gas range with griddle. Seamless indoor-outdoor living flows to a rear courtyard with summer kitchen and phantom hurricane screens. Upstairs, four ensuite bedrooms (each with unique mosaic and marble finishes) and a primary suite with oversized private balcony and spa-inspired bath create a true retreat. Mature Calophyllum trees ensure privacy throughout. Walking distance to Flagler Drive and the Intracoastal, this is West Palm Beach history — refined for today's discerning lifestyle. Original home built in 1926

The designer kitchen features Sub-Zero, Bosch, and GE appliances, while the luxurious primary suite offers dual marble baths and generous closets. Complete with a whole-house 2K gallon generator, lush landscaping, and optional country club memberships, this is Palm Beach living at its finest minutes from downtown WPB, Palm Beach Island, PBI Airport.

Dan Tyrie - Real Estate Advisor

Dan has called South Florida home since 1985, with deep roots in Palm Beach County. He began his real estate career in 2013 and brings a wealth of related experience to the table—not only as a licensed real estate professional, but also as a successful entrepreneur. Dan has built and sold both a real estate photography company and a property management business. These ventures have given him a unique, well-rounded perspective on the industry, allowing him to offer clients comprehensive guidance throughout every step of their real estate journey. Dan is known for his approachable style, strategic insight, and unwavering commitment to helping others achieve their real estate goals. Whether you're buying, selling, or investing, Dan is the kind of trusted advisor you want in your corner. Outside of work, Dan enjoys a full and active life with his girlfriend, their three growing boys, and a charismatic French Bulldog, named Chip. While parenting provides daily purpose and joy, Chip often steals the spotlight with his endless antics. An avid lover of the outdoors and live music, Dan can often be found boating along the intracoastal and hanging out at the local sandbars, biking the local trails, or catching his favorite bands in concert. He’s also a seasoned snowboarder and makes regular trips to Steamboat Springs, Colorado—a place that holds a special place in his heart from his early twenties.
